svg.text: How this FSM fits with the others
one instance runs for every booking, executed by the policy firmware on the RISC-V core.
ENTRY_ADMIT runs the entry gate FSM and EXIT_PENDING runs the exit gate FSM (4.5 slide). Gate RTL owns barrier motion and the obstruction interlock.
the 15 / 45-minute countdown runs only in HELD. A verified arrival stops it, so a later gate fault or missing backup never causes a no-show fee.
HELD_NOT_ARRIVED counts HELD. IN_TRANSIT counts ENTERED_NOT_PARKED plus parked cars that have left their bay. INSIDE_COUNT changes only on gate crossings.
a booking owns exactly one bay from commit to CLOSED. REASSIGN_LOCK swaps it atomically, so no state ever has two owners for a bay or a booking with none.
